name: Mama Reido vol. 4 Rika Mama Hen ~Ijiwaru na Ano Ko o Kawaii Mama ni Suru Houhou~
original_name: ママ隷奴 vol.4 理花ママ編 ～イジワルなあの娘を可愛いママにする方法～
source:
Frustrated by the stalled progress of her own divorce, Rika has begun to play strange pranks on Mahiro when Natsuko is not around, as a way to relieve stress.
Mahiro is confused when Rika calls him a pervert or treats him like a pervert just for touching him lightly or seeing him changing his jacket.
What's more, Rika uses this as an excuse to order Mahiro to do shopping or run personal errands for him, using him as a convenience, behind Natsuko's back.
Since it's not violent or insidious harassment, he can't bring himself to tell Natsuko, and instead, fearing that she will tell him off, he runs away from Rika, who finds it amusing and sets one naughty trap after another.
But Mahiro comes up with a plan to get revenge on his daily grudge.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/announce/=/product_id/VJ011921.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
由于对自己的离婚进展停滞不前感到沮丧，莉卡开始在夏子不在的时候对真宏玩奇怪的恶作剧，以此来缓解压力。
当莉卡称他为变态，或仅仅因为轻轻碰触他或看到他换夹克而将他视为变态时，真宏感到困惑。
更重要的是，理香以此为借口，背着夏子命令真宏为他购物或处理私人事务，利用他作为便利。
由于这不是暴力或阴险的骚扰，他无法让自己告诉夏子，相反，他担心夏子会斥责他，所以他逃离了莉卡，莉卡觉得这很有趣，并设置了一个又一个顽皮的陷阱。
但麻宏想出了一个计划来报复他每天的怨恨。
